name: Vello / vello_cpu
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Rust 2D vector renderer: GPU (vello) and deterministic CPU (vello_cpu) paths
summary: Linebender's Rust 2D renderer. vello_cpu rasterises paths, gradients, clips and layers on the CPU into an RGBA pixmap with PNG encode; vello and vello_gpu run the same scene model on wgpu. Pre-1.0 with frequent breaking releases.
use_when: Native Rust scene code needs anti-aliased paths and gradients rasterised headless to RGBA
A CPU golden-frame route is wanted from the Linebender stack that resvg also comes from
avoid_when: Static SVG rasterisation: resvg is simpler and stable
Browser-drawn scenes: capture with Playwright, or use canvas-2d
GPU output must match across machines: adapters differ, use vello_cpu

evidence.result: Rust 1.95.0 crate, vello_cpu 0.4.0 default u8 pipeline, 320x240 RGBA: rotated linear-gradient rect, radial-gradient circle, stroked cubic; 44742 transparent, 30263 opaque, 1795 partial px; 4 probes matched; two fresh processes byte-identical, PNG SHA-256 5e3aba8d81f18f76558d1713b8a2c7c131782c17ba3f3c011a4ec729fd791a15; image inspected.
evidence.scope: vello_cpu CPU raster to PNG on macOS arm64, same-machine repeatability only. No GPU vello, text, vello_svg, cross-machine identity or multithreading claim.

assessment.rationale: Apache-2.0 OR MIT, active, MSRV 1.89. vello_cpu gives a headless Rust CPU raster of paths and gradients; overlaps resvg and tiny-skia for SVG, so its niche is native scene code. Pre-1.0, breaking releases about every six weeks.

notes: 2026-11-27: Lead matched crates.io (versions, licence, MSRV 1.89). GPU vello not run; needs a Metal adapter check.
